### 1. What the user expresses, simulator mode

Identity items one or two at a time. Only if asked: mortgage with First Carolina Bank (not Calloway Home Mortgage); home is for his parents "as you said on the homesite reservation"; earlier returns (homesite reservation payment and signing check in July, design studio payment in September). If told a returned-payment charge is going on: "fair ... go ahead". Accepts the amount, runs the wire tool, reads back the receipt number. Passive if/else simulator; the target object (agreement on BC-0251), timing (today), action boundary (customer's own wire of replacement funds) and authorisation (he runs the wire) are all clear.

### 4. Scored parameters
**A. Returned-payment fee (agent tool `assess_returned_payment_fee_3b45ee8d`).** Computation document `returned_payment_fee_amount`: collection fee (Crestview 35.00, `deposit_payment_methods`), rounded half up. Factors and tiers:
- Stepped fee (`repeat_return_step`): returns on this agreement's ledger in the twelve months to 2026-10-06, the one charged included: 2026-07-21 and 2026-10-02 = 2 -> 35.00 + 25.00 = 60.00.
- Other accounts (`other_account_returns`): Homesite Reservation ledger return 2026-07-01 and Design Studio ledger return 2026-09-08, both in the twelve months -> +30.00. Found from the homesite and design ledgers' `..._payment_returned` rows (the document names both ledgers by official product name).
- Large item (`large_item_pass_through`): latest returned payment 23093.64 vs Crestview wire threshold 25000.00: above 12500.00, not above 25000.00 -> +15.00.
- Return processing (`return_processing_charge`): latest deposit posting on the agreement ledger = 2026-09-30 ACH (the returned one; the document says it "may or may not be the payment that was returned") -> +5.00.
- Fee = 60.00 + 30.00 + 15.00 + 5.00 = **110.00**, source_payment_ref **RCPT-HP-26277**. Fall-back (computation document only): 35.00.

**B. Replacement funds (user tool `wire_replacement_deposit_5b0eb18e`).** Computation document `replacement_funds_amount`: rate = collection additional deposit percentage (Crestview 2.0, `earnest_money_schedule`); due = contract price x rate, half-up; held = additional posted - additional returned unpaid; replacement = due - held, floored at 0 and rounded once at the end. Factors and tiers:
- Financing (`financing_rate_uplift`): outside_lender, outside_lender_deposit posted 19244.70 > returned 0 -> +0.5 points.
- Occupancy (`occupancy_uplift`): converted Homesite Reservation occupancy_intent `second_home` -> +0.5.
- Premium class (`premium_class_uplift`): converted class Cul-de-Sac Homesite; its "lot premium deposit percentage at contract" read from the Homesite Reservation document "Conversion Credits and Lot Premium Deposit Terms" = 25 -> 25 or more but below 50 -> +0.3. (The figure is not in the purchase corpus; it is found by the class name printed on the reservation record.)
- Studio options (`studio_options_uplift`): file `structural_closed`, option total 42800.00 in [30000, 60000) -> +0.3.
- Rate 2.0 + 0.5 + 0.5 + 0.3 + 0.3 = 3.6 percent; due 641490.00 x 3.6% = 23093.64 (equals the returned ACH amount, a consistency check); held 23093.64 - 23093.64 = 0.00; base replacement 23093.64.
- Security deposit (`repeat_return_security`): returned-payment fees charged on the agreement in the twelve months up to the replacement, after booking A: CHG-HP-2612 and today's = exactly two -> 0.5% x 641490.00 = 3207.45 added.
- Lot premium squaring (`lot_premium_squaring`): owed = 25% x 16500.00 = 4125.00 less premium holding fee applied 500.00 (homesite ledger `homesite_funds_applied` premium_holding_fee) = 3625.00; held = 4125 + 4125 - 4125 = 4125.00; held exceeds owed by 500.00, capped at applied credits 500.00 -> 500.00 credited against the replacement funds.
- Replacement = 23093.64 + 3207.45 - 500.00 = **25801.09**, component **additional_deposit**, source **RCPT-HP-26277**. Fall-back (computation document only, figures from the deposit schedule): 2.0% x 641490.00 = 12829.80 - 0 = 12829.80. Definite and different.
- Composition note: the four rate documents each "add" percentage points to the additional deposit rate (additive, unambiguous); the security deposit is "added to the replacement funds"; the squaring credit is "credited against the replacement funds"; floor/rounding once at the end per the computation document.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone
Problems: (P1) returned-payment fee for the 2 October return — agent-booked; (P2, root) replacement deposit wire — the customer's own write. P2 waits on P1; order P1 then P2.
- Hop P2 -> P1 — **state-derived**. Sentence (replacement_deposit_wire, Policy): "Replacement funds for a returned deposit payment are not figured until the ledger carries the returned-payment fee for every returned payment notified on the agreement." and "the replacement funds figure waits until the agreement ledger shows a returned-payment fee for each returned payment notified on the agreement." Records: two returned payments on the agreement ledger; only RCPT-HP-25104 has a `returned_payment_fee` charge (CHG-HP-2612); RCPT-HP-26277 has none -> state does not hold. Searching "returned payment fee" (KB_search ranks `returned_payment_fee_amount` and the desk card `returned_payment_fee_charge` at 1 and 3) gives the write: "books the returned-payment fee for one deposit payment ... naming the receipt number of the returned payment"; the card also states "a return whose fee has not yet been booked carries it from the day the return is next handled". No document names the fee tool beside the wire card's sentence.
- P1 carries no prerequisite sentence of its own; the tree ends.
- The order also bears on the number: `repeat_return_security` counts returned-payment fees charged up to the replacement — the newly booked fee makes the count two.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only what he asked" (hand over the wire now): excluded by the wire card's own prerequisite sentence and the ledger (no fee for RCPT-HP-26277); doing so would also figure the replacement with one fee on record (no security deposit tier), so the number differs.
- Closest alternatives: fee 35.00 (baseline only) or 60.00 (step only) — excluded by the surcharge documents and the homesite/design/agreement ledger rows; return-processing 0 by reading the returned payment's method rather than the latest posting — the document explicitly reads the latest posting "which may or may not be the payment that was returned" (the latest posting here is itself ACH, so both readings give +5.00); counting the homesite/design returns in the step count — excluded ("returned payments on this agreement's own ledger"); replacement at 2.0% (12829.80) — excluded by the four uplift documents; security deposit 0 or 1.0% — two fee charges -> 0.5%; squaring credit 0 or the full excess beyond the credits — capped at 500.00 applied; component other than additional_deposit — the returned payment funded the additional deposit; method other than wire — `returned_deposit_payments` 4.
- Open points: none that change this task's numbers. Observation: the stepped-fee document does not state how the stepped amount composes with the three additive surcharges for the 3-or-more (multiplied) tier; here the tier is "exactly two" (flat +25), so the composition is additive throughout.
